messages.author: a24f5cd447230d64
messages.subject: Troubles with gl.tree.nj command
parts:
Hello,

I would like to make a nj tree with my dataset of SNP. I transform it  into a genlight object but when I run "gl.tree.nj", i've a error message 

       "Error in FUN(newX[, i], ...) : arguments must have same length"

I already did a Pca with the same dataset without problems so I don't understand wich arguments must have the same lenght.




Thank you very much !

messages.author: a3ea45e87285d820
messages.subject: Re: Troubles with gl.tree.nj command
parts:
Hi Pierre,

First try

gl.tree.nj(testset.gl)

If that works,  then try

gl <- gl.compatability.check(gl)

on your genight object, then run the nj script again.

Let us know how you go.

A

messages.subject: Re: Troubles with gl.tree.nj command
parts:
Not sure what version you are using.

Try

install.packages("leaflet.providers")
install.packages("lifecycle")
install.packages("farver")
install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR", ref="dev") # no need to upgrade prior installs, answer no.

Then try what I suggested earlier.

A
